title: Leome and Partners header
description: A fixed, transparent header: a mark and a two-line wordmark at the left, a small filled Menu button at the right whose label rolls letter by letter, fill insets and outer bars shorten on hover. It opens a full-screen menu that wipes down with a clip-path, with huge links that dim the others when one is hovered.
notes: the open menu is inferred (the capture shows it closed): bg-card panel, 58px links, clip-path wipe of 1s
fixed: in a page, the first section should leave room at the top (about 7rem)
name: leome-and-partners-header

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the firm's name beside the mark, one entry per line (two short lines read best)

props.name: mark
props.description: the brand mark left of the wordmark, e.g. a lucide icon; it is sized to 4rem

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: the button's label while the menu is open

props.name: links
props.description: the links of the full-screen menu

props.name: menuFootnote
props.description: short lines along the foot of the open menu (address, phone, email…)
